package_rule: Every canonical case package contains exactly these CSV paths. Empty datasets retain the exact header.
profile_rule: Every package contains exactly one non-cumulative profile: ACADEMY, PUPPY, ADULT, or SENIOR.

columns.name: short_id
columns.description: Human-facing short identifier such as T1, P2, A4, or S3.

columns.name: mechanism
columns.description: Short description of the fraud or tutorial mechanism.

columns.name: currency_code
columns.description: ISO-like currency or in-game currency code.

columns.name: base_asset
columns.description: Optional base asset for crypto or asset-denominated cases.

columns.name: generation_mode
columns.description: SYNTHETIC, CURATED, or equivalent controlled generation mode.

columns.name: career_unlock
columns.description: Whether the case unlocks career progression.

columns.name: canonical_model_version
columns.description: Canonical model version used by the package.

columns.name: cumulative
columns.description: Must be false in canonical packages.

columns.name: no_result_charged
columns.description: Whether a no-result tool action consumes credits.

columns.name: initial_item_count
columns.description: Expected number of initial graph items.

columns.name: reason_internal
columns.description: Protected authoring reason; never exposed to the player.

columns.name: properties_json
columns.description: Canonical JSON object with registry-specific properties.

columns.name: expected_columns_json
columns.description: JSON array of expected output columns.

columns.name: record_id
columns.description: Stable record identifier within the case.

columns.name: occurred_at
columns.description: Primary event timestamp normalized to UTC.

columns.name: attributes_json
columns.description: Canonical JSON object preserving all source fields.

columns.name: source_payload_hash
columns.description: SHA-256 of the normalized source row.

columns.name: attribute_type
columns.description: STRING, INTEGER, DECIMAL, BOOLEAN, DATE, TIMESTAMP, or JSON.

columns.name: is_sensitive
columns.description: Whether the source attribute is sensitive.

columns.name: supporting_record_ids_json
columns.description: JSON array of supporting record identifiers.

columns.name: attributes_json
columns.description: Canonical JSON object with relationship-specific fields.

columns.name: actual_engine_run
columns.description: Whether the real engine produced the result.

columns.name: fixture_type
columns.description: NO_RESULT, ACTION_LEDGER, FILTER, GRAPH, CHRONOLOGY, or equivalent.

columns.name: tool_family
columns.description: MANUAL, ZINGG, GRAPHFRAMES, GENIE, EVALUATOR, or UI.

columns.name: occurred_at
columns.description: Primary event timestamp normalized to UTC.

columns.name: attribute_type
columns.description: STRING, INTEGER, DECIMAL, BOOLEAN, DATE, TIMESTAMP, or JSON.

columns.name: harm_status
columns.description: Victim, protected, neutral, beneficiary, or equivalent.

columns.name: fraud_network_membership
columns.description: Whether the entity belongs to the fraud network.

columns.name: required
columns.description: Whether the claim is required for a full solution.

columns.name: record_ids_json
columns.description: JSON array of accepted record identifiers.

columns.name: evidence_reference
columns.description: Record, relationship, query, or assertion reference.

columns.name: assertion_type
columns.description: CHRONOLOGY, CONFLICT, MISSING_VALUE, RESTART, IMMUTABILITY, FILTER, GRAPH, or equivalent.

columns.name: scope
columns.description: CONFIG, AUTHORING, ANALYTICS, PUBLISHED, GENIE, TRUTH, or PACKAGE.

columns.name: dimensions_json
columns.description: Canonical JSON object of metric dimensions.
